name: zclass_world_get_pending_fog_range
description: zClass_World::GetPendingFogRange reads the pending fog start/end distances through the world class data and returns 0.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/grid source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450bc0 validates fastcall world in ecx, outNear in edx, outFar on the stack, direct reads of worldData fog distance fields at offsets 0x20 and 0x24, return 0, and no callees.
The native smoke sets the pending fog range, calls GetPendingFogRange, and verifies both output values before ApplyPendingFogSettings consumes the same fields.
